# Development Plan - 2026-08-19

## Source
Based on research findings from `.github/research/2026-08-19-research.md`

## Executive Summary
Four actionable items identified from Cline development:
1. **Stream run command output** (HIGH) - Real-time streaming of bash/shell output
2. **Structured command form** (MODERATE) - Direct exec support via `{ command, args? }`
3. **Collapse finished runs** (MODERATE) - Work summary component for tool grouping
4. **Native notifications** (MODERATE) - OS-level notifications for task completion

All items are proven patterns from Cline production, portable to Alexi CLI/TUI architecture.

## Priority Ranking (RICE-light: Value/Effort)

### P1: Stream run command output (HIGH, ~12h)
- **Value**: HIGH - Immediate feedback for npm/build/test commands is critical for developer flow
- **Effort**: ~12h - Medium complexity (incremental yield, TUI streaming render, log retention)
- **Why P1**: High-impact UX improvement for primary CLI interaction (command execution)
- **Files**: `src/tool/tools/bash.ts`, `src/cli/tui/components/ToolRow.tsx`, new command-log persistence layer

### P2: Structured command form (MODERATE, ~6h)
- **Value**: MODERATE - Security improvement (direct exec avoids shell injection) + model flexibility
- **Effort**: ~6h - Medium complexity (union schema, spawn branch selection)
- **Why P2**: Security hardening for known command+args patterns
- **Files**: `src/tool/tools/bash.ts` (BashParamsSchema update, spawn logic)

### P3: Collapse finished runs (MODERATE, ~8h)
- **Value**: MODERATE - UX polish for long sessions (dozens of tool calls collapse into summaries)
- **Effort**: ~8h - Medium complexity (run boundary detection, WorkActivity component)
- **Why P3**: Transcript readability for multi-turn agent runs
- **Files**: New `src/cli/tui/components/WorkActivity.tsx`, `src/cli/tui/components/AnimatedDisclosure.tsx` (reuse), message projection logic

### P4: Native notifications (MODERATE, ~6h)
- **Value**: MODERATE - Quality-of-life for long-running agent tasks
- **Effort**: ~6h - Medium complexity (node-notifier integration, permission gating)
- **Why P4**: CLI users often switch away from terminal, desktop notifications valuable
- **Files**: New `src/utils/notifications.ts`, permission integration, Ink context hook

## Implementation Order

1. **Stream run command output** - Immediate value for everyday CLI usage
2. **Structured command form** - Security hardening, small surface area
3. **Collapse finished runs** - Polish for agent-mode sessions
4. **Native notifications** - Optional quality-of-life, least critical

## Dependencies & Prerequisites

- All tasks are independent, no blocking dependencies
- P1/P2 both touch `bash.ts` - implement P1 first (larger change), then P2 (schema-only)
- P3 reuses existing `AnimatedDisclosure.tsx` - no new animation infrastructure needed
- P4 requires new npm dependency (`node-notifier` or `terminal-notifier`) - update `package.json`

## Out of Scope (Not Actionable)

- Cline #13323 shared markdown pipeline - Alexi uses marked+marked-terminal, not Streamdown
- Cline #13328 provider web-search support UI - SAP AI Core does not expose native web search APIs
- Cline #13310 task-scoped settings overlay - VSCode-specific StateManager, not applicable to CLI
- Kilo commits - All JetBrains-focused (releases, Agent Manager beta, migration wizard)
- OpenCode commits - Catalog updates, session headers, SDK bumps, UI edits (no TypeScript features)

- 32 items carried from 2026-08-18 + 4 NEW today = 36 total backlog items

  - 2026-08-15 #1: Image generation (HIGH, ~8h) - SAP AI Core supports image-gen models
  - 2026-07-30 #1: MCP per-server timeout (HIGH)
  - 2026-07-28 #2: Connector persistence (MODERATE)
  - 2026-07-28 #3: Free-model rate-limit UX (MODERATE)

## Testing Strategy

- P1 (streaming): Test with long-running commands (npm install, vitest watch, build), verify incremental output append, log retention on detach
- P2 (structured form): Test direct exec vs shell fallback, ENOENT handling, argument boundary preservation
- P3 (work summary): Test run boundary detection, collapse gating, duration+tool-count formatting
- P4 (notifications): Test across macOS/Linux, permission gating, notification triggers on task completion

## Success Metrics

- P1: Users see command output live (no waiting for exit), progress bars render in real-time
- P2: Models can request direct execution for security-sensitive commands (git, npm with known args)
- P3: Long transcripts collapse completed work into one-line summaries, final answers stay visible
- P4: Desktop notifications fire when agent completes long-running tasks, users notified without watching terminal
